summary.text: Curtis Gibson, a Democratic commercial property manager and former Lake Wales city commissioner, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 18th Congressional District to incumbent Scott Franklin.
He describes his earlier working jobs and calls himself a working-class voice and not a career politician.

paragraphs.text: Gibson graduated from Lake Wales High School, earned an associate degree from Bryant & Stratton College in 2017, and received a bachelor's degree in interdisciplinary business studies from Kaiser University in 2021.
He describes his past jobs as school board janitor, U.S. Postal Service mail carrier, Amazon Air employee and professional wrestler.
He served as a Lake Wales City Commissioner from 2017 to 2021.
Gibson works as a commercial property and mall manager, according to his survey responses, which cite experience in local business growth and lease negotiations.
He says he lives in Polk County with his wife, Danielle, their five children and a foster child.
He advanced to the general election without a primary after the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
He received 46.7% of the vote to Scott Franklin's 50.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
